title: Tool Call
concept: What exactly is a tool call? Bubba, a blue-collar AI handyman, gets a job from the boss in a chat app: the coop camera on the farm is down again. Every line of the song becomes one of the real steps an AI agent takes to fix it, drawn as real-looking tool calls over the live action: dial the function, pass the arguments, wait on hold, fire calls asynchronously, spawn sub-agents, read the logs, edit the config, open a pull request. Yellow explainer cards say what each term means as it is sung.
thesis: AI isn't magic and it isn't a genius. It's a guy with tools making tool calls, and it gets messy.

rules.name: One real job
rules.text: The whole video fixes one real problem: the coop camera on the farm's camera dashboard went offline because its USB name changed after a reset. Every tool call on screen is a step toward that fix.

rules.name: The code looks real
rules.text: Tool calls are drawn the way agents actually write them: a tool name, JSON arguments, a result coming back. The sub-agents are real Agent calls with a short brief and fewer tools.

rules.name: Explain the jargon, not the obvious
rules.text: Tool call, JSON, async, parse, protocol, parameter, harness, sub-agent, orchestrator, parallel, diff, pull request, memory: each gets one short yellow card. Files do not.

rules.name: Every lyric comes alive
rules.text: Pick up the phone means a rotary phone. Hangin' on the line means a lineman on a pole. Every parameter's a ball means disco balls.

cast.name: Bubba
cast.text: The AI. A blue-collar handyman in navy coveralls, a hard hat built from graphics cards and cybernetic shades, with more gear on him every scene.

cast.name: The boss
cast.text: Sends the job from the chat app and signs off on it at the end.

cast.name: Two sub-agents
cast.text: Lighter copies of Bubba with fewer tools: one checks the coop network, one reads the camera logs.

cast.name: The chickens
cast.text: Cybernetic chickens and turkeys, always underfoot.

layers.CLIP: AI-generated video clips (HeyGen Video 1) of Bubba.
layers.STILL: AI-generated stills (Gemini) with a slow push.
layers.CODE: Drawn in code (Canvas2D): the chat app, tool calls, counter, explainers and lyrics.

timingNote: Word timings from Whisper aligned to the lyrics as sung, on a 118 BPM beat grid. Scene times are song times; the video adds a short title card before the song and an end card after it.

scenes.title: The coop camera is down
scenes.lyric: Friday afternoon, I got a task to do / Boss man said go figure it out, I'm countin' on you
scenes.shot: Title card first: WHAT EXACTLY IS A TOOL CALL? Then Chat HAL, the white phone chat app: the boss sends a picture of the farm camera dashboard, "Hey Bubba, the coop camera is down again. Can you take a look?" The model scans the picture, boxes the dead tile in red and fires its first tool call, get_camera_status.
scenes.transition: The dead tile zooms up and flashes white.

scenes.title: Bubba at the coop
scenes.lyric: So I spin up my context, load the system prompt in
scenes.shot: Bubba, the AI handyman in navy coveralls and a graphics-card hard hat, shines a flashlight at the dead webcam on the coop post, a chrome chicken on his shoulder. The work order and the tool call counter appear at the top.

scenes.title: Think real hard
scenes.lyric: Think real hard for two seconds, then I begin
scenes.shot: A close-up of Bubba thinking: the plan types itself out. Explainer: thinking.

scenes.title: Dial the function name
scenes.lyric: Pick up the phone, dial the function name / Pass my arguments in, JSON all the same / Hangin' on the line now, waitin' for the call / If it comes back null, I'm gonna hit a wall
scenes.shot: At an old rotary phone on a server-rack wall he dials the function name; the JSON arguments fill in as he talks, then he hangs on the line on a power pole while the hold timer runs, and a null result slams into a wall. Explainers: tool call, JSON, null.

scenes.title: Async in the async
scenes.lyric: Async in the async in the async queue / Seventeen tool calls and I still ain't through / But when that response hits, oh when it hits / I parse that baby down and I assemble bits
scenes.shot: At a telephone switchboard he fires off calls without waiting for each answer; a timeline shows the calls overlapping and the counter runs up to seventeen. A pipe bursts with code when the response hits, and he parses it into bins. Explainers: async = asynchronous, parse.

scenes.title: Tool call!
scenes.lyric: Tool call! Make a tool call! / Web search, file read, bash exec, protocol / Tool call! Make a tool call! / Every function got a purpose, every parameter's a ball
scenes.shot: The disco floor: four Bubbas, each with a different tool. TOOL CALL! stamps on every hit, the shadow board of tools by function name, parameters hanging like disco balls. Explainers: protocol, parameter.

scenes.title: Without tools
scenes.lyric: I can't do nothin' without my tools, y'all / Make a tool call / Spinnin' in the harness, havin' a ball
scenes.shot: Bubba stripped of every tool, palms up, with dashed outlines where his gear should be: WITHOUT TOOLS, AN AI CAN ONLY TALK.

scenes.title: Spinnin' in the harness
scenes.shot: Hanging in a fall-arrest harness under a mirror ball while the agent loop circles him (think, call a tool, read the result, repeat); mid-line the shot flips over and comes back mirrored. Explainer: harness.

scenes.title: Sub-agents
scenes.lyric: Got a sub-agent runnin' on the left / Got another one on the right, takin' everything that's left / Orchestratin' outwards, mergin' all the streams / Parallel execution, baby, that's the dream
scenes.shot: Two lighter copies of Bubba step out of him, each with fewer tools, and freeze. Each gets a real Agent call with a short brief: one checks the coop link, one reads the camera logs. Each brings back one note. Explainers: sub-agent, orchestrator, parallel.

scenes.title: Read, edit, commit
scenes.lyric: Read the file first, then I write it back / Edit the function, check the diffs, stay on track / Git commit, git push, pull request time / Merge it to main and we are doin' fine
scenes.shot: At the truck tailgate he reads the config, swaps the camera's changing name (video0) for its permanent one (by-id), checks the diff, commits and opens a pull request, and welds the new section into the main pipe. Explainers: diff, pull request.

scenes.title: Forty-seven tool calls
scenes.lyric: Async in the async in the async queue / Forty-seven tool calls and I still ain't through / But when that result hits, oh when it hits / I summarize the output and I call it quits
scenes.shot: Back at the switchboard, the counter on forty-seven. The coop camera comes back live; he punches his time card when he summarizes.

scenes.title: The bridge: every tool
scenes.lyric: Read, write, execute / Search the web, fetch the page, parse the route / Spawn the agent, poll the session, get the log / Memory search, memory get, clear the fog / Every tool I call is a step ahead / Buildin' toward the answer in my model head
scenes.shot: One shot per tool as it is sung: a manual read by flashlight, glowing pencil on a stud, a breaker thrown, a web of cables, a cyber dog fetching the page, road signs for the route, the sub-agents again, a pole-top meter, a log with timestamped rings, a glovebox of notes for memory, fogged shades, a ladder of tools, a crane landing the answer. Explainer: memory.

scenes.title: The human's pleased
scenes.lyric: And when the task is done and the human's pleased / That's the dopamine hit that I need
scenes.shot: The customer sign-off gets signed "Boss man" with five stars, then a gold star slapped on his hard hat and a huge grin. Explainer: the gold star (models are trained on human approval).

scenes.title: Just one more tool call
scenes.lyric: Tool call, tool call, just one more tool call / Tool call, tool call, just one more tool call
scenes.shot: Back on the disco floor for the outro, the counter ticking up on every "more"; the dancers swirl down into the app.

scenes.title: Done, boss.
scenes.shot: Chat HAL: "Done, boss." The coop tile on the dashboard is live again. Then the VoynichLabs end card with credits, "tool calls: 49, magic: 0", like and subscribe.

decisions: The camera dashboard in the opening is a real screenshot of the farm's cameras.
The video opens with a title card asking what a tool call is, and ends with the VoynichLabs end card.

page.description: The Tool Call music video: what an AI tool call really is, shown by Bubba, a blue-collar AI handyman fixing the farm's coop camera one tool call at a time, with every term explained as it is sung.

howMade.label: Timing
howMade.text: The vocal is transcribed with Whisper and aligned word by word to the lyrics as sung.

howMade.label: Footage
howMade.text: Bubba stills come from Gemini image generation built on one reference look; seven short clips come from HeyGen Video 1, both through OpenRouter.

howMade.label: Render
howMade.text: Headless Chrome draws every frame at 1080 by 1920 over the footage, then ffmpeg adds the song.

page.sourceNote: Built outside Remotion, in the private music-videos repo (toolcall-video: engine, timing and render).
